modules.responsibility: bounded public transport and stable response mapping
entities, validation policy, and state invariants
media probing, event analysis, transforms, and bundle encoding
exclusive identity locks and atomic persistence

entities.label: Media take
invariants: The combined digest describes exactly the stored audio and picture bytes
A take identifier resolves to one immutable record
A failed probe leaves no visible take directory

entities.label: Sync analysis
invariants: A ready analysis has finite event times and a signed offset
Terminal analysis records cannot be rewritten
A failed analysis cannot produce a conform

entities.label: Conform job
invariants: Completed and failed are terminal
A completed job exposes one bundle whose digest matches its receipt
A failed job exposes no bundle route

entities.label: Conform receipt
invariants: The receipt records the exact applied sample correction
The receipt bundle digest equals the visible ZIP digest
The receipt picture frame count equals the admitted take

state_machines.subject: media_take
invariants: Only a fully probed take becomes admitted
An identical retry returns the existing admitted record
A conflicting identifier reuse never replaces the existing record

state_machines.subject: sync_analysis
invariants: Ready and failed are terminal
Only ready analyses expose a usable event pair
Only ready analyses can start a conform

state_machines.subject: conform_job
invariants: Completed and failed are terminal
A visible completed bundle has a matching receipt
Temporary bundle content is removed after failure

extension_seams.distinct_outcome: A second audio or picture format can be admitted while preserving take and storage contracts.
Adaptive thresholds can change event selection without changing analysis states or public fields.

extension_seams.anchor: internal/media AlignAudio and domain correction bounds
extension_seams.distinct_outcome: Fractional-rate correction can replace integer sample alignment while preserving receipt semantics.

extension_seams.anchor: internal/storage Repository methods used by every workflow
extension_seams.entry: take, analysis, and conform service calls
extension_seams.distinct_outcome: A transactional repository can replace the current storage layout without changing HTTP or media contracts.

tension_points.description: Computing a combined digest before publication versus exposing payloads while an identifier race is still unresolved
tension_points.observable_failure: Two concurrent admissions both appear accepted, or a digest points to bytes different from the stored payloads.

tension_points.description: Choosing the strongest picture flash versus requiring a statistically distinct audio onset at a compatible time
tension_points.observable_failure: A confident-looking analysis pairs unrelated events, or a failed analysis retains usable event times.

tension_points.description: Applying the exact audio correction versus refusing an offset beyond the operator ceiling and preserving identity-time picture
tension_points.observable_failure: Audio is moved farther than requested, or a failed conform leaves a fetchable partial archive.
